provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: A controlled bivariate normal utilization density in each habitat, with the same physical axis units and no additional scaling. The 95 percent joint ellipse consists of x such that (x-mu)^T Sigma_inverse (x-mu)<=c, with c=-2*ln(0.05) for two dimensions. Its area is pi*c*sqrt(det(Sigma)); translations do not affect area.
target: Compare actual joint ellipse areas and, separately, the product of the two marginal standard deviations. Do not decorrelate by independently standardizing habitats or replace the joint ellipse by a rectangular product of marginal 95 percent intervals.
scope: Covariance geometry under an explicit utilization model, not inferred environmental tolerance, niche causality or a species distribution prediction.
